viewing_check: Check the steps in front of Parliament House under magnification (count them, and see whether they are sharp or worn), check for cleaning, scratches, rim knocks, and confirm the coin is a genuine 1927 strike (not a copy) and grade (VF vs EF). Single circulated coins have mostly sold at $34-60 hammer; only a clearly EF coin with sharp steps is likely to go higher.
